title: Timberlin Golf Course
specs: 18-hole municipal golf course with par 72 layout and 6,733 yards from championship tees
Located along the base of Ragged Mountain with rolling terrain and farmland views
Golfers must pay greens fee or present season pass before play
Golfers must be properly dressed: shirts, slacks or shorts; no bathing suits
Golf shoes or approved footwear required; no metal spikes
Groups of four required during busy times; groups of five only with approval
Players expected to complete 9 holes in no more than 2 hours 10 minutes

blurb: Timberlin Golf Club offers an 18-hole municipal golf course designed by Al Zikorus, featuring rolling terrain and views of surrounding farmland. The course is suitable for beginners and experts alike. Additional amenities include a golf shop, PGA professional instruction, and a full-service restaurant.
